svg.title: Local housing measures, Nov. 3, 2026 (unofficial)
svg.desc: Map of Colorado with the eight local housing measures tracked by COHO Analytics. 1 Broomfield 1A, Lodging tax for the Housing Authority, too close to call, 50.7% yes; 2 Lakewood 2G, Sales tax, public safety incl. homelessness, failed, 40.4% yes; 3 Cherry Hills Village 2C, Local-only zoning in charter, passed, 84.2% yes; 4 Castle Pines 300, Vote required to annex 20+ acres, passed, 71.6% yes; 5 Castle Pines 301, Refer recent annexations to voters, passed, 64.6% yes; 6 Mt. Crested Butte 2A, Short-term rental tax for housing, too close to call, 54.6% yes; 7 Salida 5-H R-2, Rezoning a property to R-2, failed, 37.5% yes; 8 San Juan County 1A, Lodging tax; 45% to housing and child care, passed, 60.0% yes. Unofficial results as of 2026-11-04.
svg.text: Unofficial results as of 2026-11-04. Counts may change until certified.
